propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot file must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) under the git-tracked `.rebar/` directory so trend history accumulates across CI runs.

The snapshot store file `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` must be explicitly un-ignored in `.gitignore` via a `!`-negation rule because the blanket `.rebar/*` rule would otherwise prevent it from being committed.
write_snapshot(dict) appends a timestamped JSON record to the snapshot file; read_snapshots(since, until) filters and yields records within the given date range.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines must be silently skipped during read without raising an error, so the reader recovers valid records even if the file is partially corrupted.
Unit tests must verify round-trip write/read consistency, range filtering correctness, and that the snapshot file location is not matched by the repository's .gitignore rules.
